tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: System evolution review (system_evolution_review)
Goal: Diagnose maintenance pressure and propose the smallest governed change supported by real use evidence.
Read first: docs/self-evolution-control-plane.en.md
User should provide: Describe the maintenance pain, recent repository change, or real task that exposed a system gap.
Confirmation boundary: Human confirmation is required before durable, code, schema, provider, public, Git, network, or external changes.
Return judgment and candidate output first. Durable memory or public content must use the existing Review/confirmation flow.

authority.source_owner: Confirmed repository files, the public maintenance contract, and explicit user feedback remain the source authority.
authority.candidate_owner: Diagnostics and proposed system changes remain candidate-only until reviewed.
authority.durable_owner: Use answer, artifact, or the existing Review flow; this plugin owns no storage.
authority.summary: Human confirmation is required before durable, code, schema, provider, public, Git, network, or external changes.
